title: The punch in the alley
phrase: two guys fight in an alley and I want to feel every punch, raw and shaky

commands.plan: python3 scripts/shotspeak.py plan --phrase "two guys fight in an alley and I want to feel every punch, raw and shaky" --subject "two stunt fighters in plain dark clothes" --action "trading blows, one hard right hook lands on the jaw" --setting "a narrow brick alley at night" --out examples/alley-fight

bad.prompt: epic fight scene between two men in a dark alley, cinematic, dramatic lighting, slow motion, camera circling around them, wet street, volumetric fog, 4k
bad.what_you_get: Two men who look the same and dance around each other in slow motion. No punch lands. A wet floor, fog, and a camera that circles.
tells: Bloom, haze, fog and god rays

plain.prompt: Two men fight in a narrow brick alley at night. One man throws a hard right hook. The punch lands on the other man's jaw, and he steps back.
plain.what_you_get: A wide view of 2 small men. The punch is slow and soft, and it stops before the jaw. The camera does not help.

skill.pro_term: Contact insert with a ramp on contact
skill.plain_words: A tight shot of the instant of contact. Slow on the way in, full speed from the contact.
skill.feel: The viewer feels the contact, not only sees it.
skill.what_you_get: A tight side-on view of the jaw. The fist comes in slowly and lands at full speed. The frame kicks with the force.

decisions.Camera movement: locked and tight on the point of contact; at the frame of contact the frame kicks a hand's width in the direction of the force, then settles
decisions.Camera placement: exactly side-on to the line of the force, at chest height, 2 m away, never in front of a face

skill.prompt_block:
SHOT: Contact insert with a ramp on contact. 16:9 frame, 1.5 to 2.5 s.
SUBJECT AND ACTION: two stunt fighters in plain dark clothes trading blows, one hard right hook lands on the jaw, in a narrow brick alley at night.
CAMERA MOVE: locked and tight on the point of contact; at the frame of contact the frame kicks a hand's width in the direction of the force, then settles.
CAMERA PLACEMENT: exactly side-on to the line of the force, at chest height, 2 m away, never in front of a face.
LENS: 85 mm.
LIGHT: night; the only light comes from sources visible in the place, each with its own colour and a short reach; large areas of true darkness between them.
COLOUR: bleach-bypass look: high contrast, low saturation, silvery highlights, dense blacks, visible grain.
SPEED: slow motion on the approach, then real speed from the exact frame of contact: the reaction happens at full speed and the shot ends when the reaction ends.
RULES: State the exact number of people. Screen direction stays the same for the whole shot.
AVOID: real time, with slow motion only where the shot states it; no slow floating camera drift; the camera is locked or makes one decisive move with a clear end; nobody looks into the lens; every eyeline goes to a target inside the scene; real gravity and real jump height, nobody floats; no bloom, no haze, no fog, no volumetric god rays; no soft even glow; one motivated light source with a real dark side; worn real textures with dust, creases and small defects, nothing plastic or perfectly clean.
skill.one_line: A tight contact insert: two stunt fighters in plain dark clothes trading blows, one hard right hook lands on the jaw, exactly side-on to the line of the force, the frame kicking a hand's width with the force at the contact; 85 mm lens; night; the only light comes from sources visible in the place, each with its own colour and a short reach; large areas of true darkness between them; bleach-bypass look: high contrast, low saturation, silvery highlights, dense blacks, visible grain; slow motion on the approach, then real speed from the exact frame of contact: the reaction happens at full speed and the shot ends when the reaction ends. Avoid: real time, with slow motion only where the shot states it; no slow floating camera drift; the camera is locked or makes one decisive move with a clear end; nobody looks into the lens; every eyeline goes to a target inside the scene; real gravity and real jump height, nobody floats; no bloom, no haze, no fog, no volumetric god rays.
skill.image_prompt:
A single still frame from a live-action film, 16:9 frame. A storyboard-grade production mock that shows framing, lens, light and colour.
SUBJECT: two stunt fighters in plain dark clothes trading blows, one hard right hook lands on the jaw, in a narrow brick alley at night. Generic stand-in figures, not a likeness of any real person.
CAMERA: a tight side-on frame of the instant of contact, the point of contact on one third of the frame, the one who takes the force in profile. Camera placement: exactly side-on to the line of the force, at chest height, 2 m away, never in front of a face.
LENS: 85 mm; long lens look: compressed depth, the background pulled close and out of focus with natural optical falloff.
LIGHT: night; the only light comes from sources visible in the place, each with its own colour and a short reach; large areas of true darkness between them.
COLOUR: bleach-bypass look: high contrast, low saturation, silvery highlights, dense blacks, visible grain.
MOMENT: the exact frame of contact: the moving part stopped on its target, the surface pushed in, everything sharp.
FACES: turned away from the lens, in profile, three-quarter or from behind.
AVOID: real time, with slow motion only where the shot states it; no slow floating camera drift; the camera is locked or makes one decisive move with a clear end; nobody looks into the lens; every eyeline goes to a target inside the scene; no soft even glow; one motivated light source with a real dark side; no bloom, no haze, no fog, no volumetric god rays; matte worn floor, no glossy or wet reflections; worn real textures with dust, creases and small defects, nothing plastic or perfectly clean; no over-saturated HDR look; restrained colour and true blacks; real gravity and real jump height, nobody floats.
One frame only: no collage, no split screen, no text, no captions, no logos, no watermark, no border.
